name: Portfolio Laravel
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude && sudo PHP_INI_DIR=$PHP_INI_DIR docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql && composer install && cp -n .env.example .env && sed -i 's/^DB_HOST=.*/DB_HOST=db/; s/^DB_DATABASE=.*/DB_DATABASE=larosite/; s/^DB_USERNAME=.*/DB_USERNAME=laravel/; s/^DB_PASSWORD=.*/DB_PASSWORD=secret/' .env && php artisan key:generate
